packages.name: better-auth
relevant_topics: passing a better-sqlite3 Database instance as `database`
programmatic schema migration via better-auth/db/migration getMigrations(...).runMigrations()
server-side auth.api.* returning plain objects (not Response)
trustedOrigins + CSRF origin checks on cookie POSTs
doc_omissions: 1.7.18 does NOT auto-create its tables when given a database connection: first use throws SchemaMismatchError (SCHEMA_MISMATCH) telling you to run the CLI. The programmatic path (better-auth/db/migration -> getMigrations(auth.options) -> runMigrations()) is under-documented.
During first-time table creation runMigrations() logs a transient 'Database schema mismatch ... Missing tables' ERROR even though creation then succeeds; subsequent boots are clean. Not documented.
Server-side auth.api.signUpEmail returns the created user object directly, while the HTTP endpoint returns { token, user }; docs do not call this asymmetry out.
POST /api/auth/sign-out with a JSON content-type but empty body returns 400; docs do not mention that a body is expected.

Auth routes answer with Better Auth's native JSON error format (observed: wrong credentials -> 401 {"message":"Invalid email or password","code":"INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD"}), not the Workboard envelope; docs do not present a unified error taxonomy (re-verified in R1, recorded in baseline contract §5).
createAuthClient() origin inference: docs describe an explicit baseURL pattern; same-origin inference works but the default-host behavior is easy to misconfigure silently.
Docs present Kysely as the custom-database path; passing a better-sqlite3 instance directly also works in 1.7.18 (verified) but is thinly documented.

packages.name: @playwright/test
relevant_topics: webServer with env + health URL (reuseExistingServer: false in R1)
chromium headless shell install (`npx playwright install chromium --only-shell`)
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH cache relocation must be set for install AND run
route interception for delayed/aborted switch and delayed-action regressions (e2e/switch.spec.ts)
doc_omissions: Browsers are not installed by npm install; the headless shell must be installed once per environment (documented in baseline README + contract §2). A relocated cache (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH) must be set for BOTH the install and every test run; a mismatch makes the run look in the default cache and exit 1 ('Executable doesn't exist').

The headless shell still needs chromium's shared system libraries (NSS, fontconfig, and related packages); docs point to `npx playwright install-deps chromium` for that, which was not exercised in the preparation sandbox.

Host-OS support: the preparation sandbox could not read /etc/os-release, and Playwright's own banner reported the host as unsupported and downloaded an Ubuntu 24.04 fallback build, after which the pinned tests passed. 'Ubuntu 24.04' is the fallback's label, not a verified host OS; the fixture docs do not claim any specific host OS.
